name: sq80-fm1
author: Leonardo Lopez Chavira
tagline: an Ensoniq SQ-80 for the FM-1, on your own ROMs
description: An unofficial Ensoniq SQ-80 for the FM-1, written from scratch: three wavetable oscillators, a resonant 4-pole filter, four envelopes and three LFOs per voice, eight voices on two cores. It plays the SQ-80 waves and programs you load into it from your own ROM dumps and SysEx banks (none are included); without them, a synthetic test wave set.
credits: Built on fm1-base (MPL-2.0); the effects are FMini-1's by Ruppert, after Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments; the arpeggiator, sequencer and recording are SLOOP's, by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments (GPL-3.0).
